Dazzling Leonid meteor shower to peak on Tuesday night

The Leonid meteor shower, known for its bright and fast meteors, is set to peak on Tuesday night.

[Source 2 — www.theguardian.com (Bias: Left / Progressive)] (URL: https://www.theguardian.com/science/2026/nov/16/starwatch-fleeting-brilliance-of-leonid-meteor-shower-to-hit-peak):
Starwatch: Fleeting brilliance of Leonid meteor shower to hit peak

Annual display appears to radiate from constellation of Leo in eastern sky as Earth passes through comet debris streamThe annual Leonid meteor shower reaches its peak this week, offering a chance to count meteors. The shower is expected to be at its most active during the night of 17–18 November. Under ideal conditions, observers may see up to 10–15 meteors an hour.What they lack in numbers, they make up for in brilliance. Continue reading...
